title_en: VDW-GNNs: Vector diffusion wavelets for geometric graph neural networks
title_zh: VDW-GNN：用于几何图神经网络的向量扩散小波

sentences.en: We introduce vector diffusion wavelets (VDWs), a novel family of wavelets inspired by the vector diffusion maps algorithm that was introduced to analyze data lying in the tangent bundle of a Riemannian manifold.
sentences.zh: 我们引入向量扩散小波（vector diffusion wavelets, VDWs），这是一个受向量扩散映射算法启发的新型小波族，该算法最初被用于分析位于黎曼流形切丛中的数据。

sentences.en: We show that these wavelets may be effectively incorporated into a family of geometric graph neural networks, which we refer to as VDW-GNNs.
sentences.zh: 我们证明这些小波可以被有效地整合进一族几何图神经网络中，我们将其称为 VDW-GNN。

sentences.en: We demonstrate that such networks are effective on synthetic point cloud data, as well as on real-world data derived from wind field and neural activity measurements.
sentences.zh: 我们证明此类网络在合成点云数据以及源自风场与神经活动测量的真实世界数据上都十分有效。

sentences.en: Theoretically, we prove that these new wavelets have desirable frame theoretic properties, similar to traditional diffusion wavelets.
sentences.zh: 理论上，我们证明这些新小波具有理想的框架理论性质，与传统扩散小波类似。

sentences.en: Additionally, we prove that these wavelets have useful symmetries with respect to rotations and translations.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们证明这些小波在旋转与平移下具有有用的对称性。

title_en: VecDesigner: Exploring Visual Guidance and Structural Consistency for Semantic Typography
title_zh: VecDesigner：面向语义字体的视觉引导与结构一致性探索

sentences.en: Semantic Typography aims to visualize the meaning of an input word through the form of a character, while preserving its legibility.
sentences.zh: 语义字体旨在通过字形来视觉化输入单词的含义，同时保持其可读性。

sentences.en: Existing vector-based methods, which primarily rely on text-driven optimization like Score Distillation Sampling (SDS), often produce glyphs that lack rich semantic details.
sentences.zh: 现有的基于矢量的方法主要依赖诸如分数蒸馏采样（Score Distillation Sampling, SDS）之类的文本驱动优化，往往生成缺乏丰富语义细节的字形。

sentences.en: Furthermore, these approaches struggle to maintain the overall structural integrity of the glyphs and frequently suffer from visual artifacts caused by intersections, compromising both readability and aesthetic quality.
sentences.zh: 此外，这些方法难以保持字形整体的结构完整性，且经常因笔画相交而产生视觉伪影，损害了可读性与美学质量。

sentences.en: To address these challenges, we propose VecDesigner, a novel optimization-based method for vector semantic typography.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们提出 VecDesigner，一种新颖的、基于优化的矢量语义字体方法。

sentences.en: Specifically, we introduce Visual-Guided Score Distillation Sampling (VGSDS), which leverages text-related reference images as visual guidance to infuse the glyphs with richer and more concrete semantic details.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们引入视觉引导的分数蒸馏采样（Visual-Guided Score Distillation Sampling, VGSDS），利用与文本相关的参考图像作为视觉引导，为字形注入更丰富、更具体的语义细节。

sentences.en: To preserve legibility and structural integrity, we design a vector-based Procrustes loss to constrain the overall deformation of the glyph.
sentences.zh: 为保持可读性与结构完整性，我们设计了一种基于矢量的 Procrustes 损失，以约束字形的整体形变。

sentences.en: Concurrently, we effectively mitigate the intersection problem by imposing positional relationship constraints on the control points.
sentences.zh: 同时，我们通过对控制点施加位置关系约束，有效缓解了笔画相交问题。

sentences.en: Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that VecDesigner outperforms existing methods in both semantic expression and structural preservation, generating high-quality, expressive, and clearly legible semantic glyphs.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，VecDesigner 在语义表达与结构保持两方面都优于现有方法，能够生成高质量、富有表现力且清晰可读的语义字形。

title_en: VecMol: Vector-Field Representations for 3D Molecule Generation
title_zh: VecMol：面向 3D 分子生成的向量场表示

sentences.en: Generative modeling of three-dimensional (3D) molecules is a fundamental yet challenging problem in drug discovery and materials science.
sentences.zh: 三维（3D）分子的生成建模是药物发现与材料科学中一个基础而又富有挑战性的问题。

sentences.en: Existing approaches typically represent molecules as 3D graphs and co-generate discrete atom types with continuous atomic coordinates, leading to intrinsic learning difficulties such as heterogeneous modality entanglement and geometry–chemistry coherence constraints.
sentences.zh: 现有方法通常将分子表示为 3D 图，并将离散原子类型与连续原子坐标一起生成，这会导致异质模态纠缠、几何-化学一致性约束等固有的学习困难。

sentences.en: We propose VecMol, a novel representation that models 3D molecules as continuous vector fields over Euclidean space, where vectors point toward nearby atoms and implicitly encode molecular structure.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 VecMol，一种新颖的表示，它将 3D 分子建模为欧几里得空间上的连续向量场，其中向量指向邻近原子，并隐式编码分子结构。

sentences.en: The vector field is parameterized by a neural field and generated using a latent diffusion model, avoiding explicit graph generation and decoupling structure learning from discrete atom instantiation.
sentences.zh: 该向量场由神经场参数化，并使用潜扩散模型生成，从而避免显式的图生成，并将结构学习与离散原子实例化解耦。

sentences.en: Experiments on the QM9 and GEOM-Drugs benchmarks demonstrate that VecMol achieves competitive generation quality, suggesting vector-field-based representations as a promising new direction for 3D molecular generation.
sentences.zh: 在 QM9 与 GEOM-Drugs 基准上的实验表明，VecMol 取得了具有竞争力的生成质量，这说明基于向量场的表示是 3D 分子生成的一个有前景的新方向。

title_en: Vector Linking via Cross-Model Local Isometric Consistency
title_zh: 通过跨模型局部等距一致性进行向量链接

sentences.en: We study Vector Linking: given two embedding clouds produced by different black-box encoders over partially overlapping datasets, recover cross-model object correspondences using only vectors.
sentences.zh: 我们研究向量链接（Vector Linking）：给定由不同黑盒编码器在部分重叠数据集上产生的两个嵌入云，仅利用向量恢复跨模型的物体对应关系。

sentences.en: Empirically and theoretically, we show that independently trained contrastive encoders exhibit local geometric consistency: short-range distances are approximately preserved up to a scale factor, while long-range distances are not due to model-specific distortion.
sentences.zh: 我们通过实验与理论证明，独立训练的对比编码器表现出局部几何一致性：短程距离在相差一个缩放因子的意义上被近似保持，而长程距离则因模型特有失真而无法保持。

sentences.en: Building on this, we propose an iterative, reference-based geometric embedding hashing that recovers vector links from a tiny seed set of paired anchors.
sentences.zh: 基于此，我们提出一种迭代的、基于参照的几何嵌入哈希方法，它能从极小的配对锚点种子集中恢复向量链接。

sentences.en: It represents each vector by distances to sampled paired anchors, proposes candidate links via hash-space matching, and aggregates evidence across views in a Beta--Bernoulli posterior to bootstrap high-confidence links as new anchors.
sentences.zh: 它用每个向量到采样配对锚点的距离来表示该向量，通过哈希空间匹配提出候选链接，并在 Beta-Bernoulli 后验中跨视角聚合证据，将高置信链接自助采样为新锚点。

sentences.en: Experiments across multiple benchmarks and embedding model pairs demonstrate accurate and robust linking under varying overlap, seed budgets, and out-of-domain references, with applications to vector database integration and cross-model clustering.
sentences.zh: 跨多个基准与嵌入模型对的实验表明，在变化的覆盖率、种子预算与域外参照下，链接既准确又鲁棒，并可用于向量数据库集成与跨模型聚类。

sentences.en: Code is available at \url{https://github.com/DBgroup-Edinburgh/VecLinking}.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 \url{https://github.com/DBgroup-Edinburgh/VecLinking} 获取。

title_en: VectorWorld: Efficient Streaming World Model via Diffusion Flow on Vector Graphs
title_zh: VectorWorld：通过向量图上的扩散流实现高效的流式世界模型

sentences.en: Closed-loop evaluation of autonomous-driving policies requires interactive simulation beyond log replay.
sentences.zh: 自动驾驶策略的闭环评估需要超越日志回放的交互式仿真。

sentences.en: However, existing generative world models often degrade in closed loop due to (i) history-free initialization that mismatches policy inputs, (ii) multi-step sampling latency that violates real-time budgets, and (iii) compounding kinematic infeasibility over long horizons.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有的生成式世界模型在闭环中常常退化，原因包括（i）与策略输入不匹配的无历史初始化，（ii）违反实时预算的多步采样延迟，以及（iii）在长时间范围上不断累积的运动学不可行性。

sentences.en: We propose VectorWorld, a streaming world model that incrementally generates ego-centric $64 \mathrm{m}\times 64\mathrm{m}$ lane--agent vector-graph tiles during rollout.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 VectorWorld，一种流式世界模型，它在 rollout 过程中增量式地生成以自我为中心的 $64 \mathrm{m}\times 64\mathrm{m}$ 车道-智能体向量图块。

sentences.en: VectorWorld aligns initialization with history-conditioned policies by producing a policy-compatible interaction state via a motion-aware gated VAE.
sentences.zh: VectorWorld 通过运动感知的门控 VAE 生成与策略兼容的交互状态，从而使初始化与基于历史条件的策略相对齐。

sentences.en: It enables real-time outpainting via solver-free one-step masked completion with an edge-gated relational DiT trained with interval-conditioned MeanFlow and JVP-based large-step supervision.
sentences.zh: 它通过免求解的一步掩码补全实现实时外扩，采用经区间条件 MeanFlow 与基于 JVP 的大步长监督训练的边门控关系型 DiT。

sentences.en: To stabilize long-horizon rollouts, we introduce $\Delta$Sim, a physics-aligned non-ego (NPC) policy with hybrid discrete--continuous actions and differentiable kinematic logit shaping.
sentences.zh: 为稳定长时间 rollout，我们引入 $\Delta$Sim，一种物理对齐的非自我（NPC）策略，具有混合离散-连续动作与可微的运动学 logit 整形。

sentences.en: On Waymo open motion and nuPlan, VectorWorld improves map-structure fidelity and initialization validity, and supports stable, real-time $1\mathrm{km}+$ closed-loop rollouts.
sentences.zh: 在 Waymo open motion 与 nuPlan 上，VectorWorld 提升了地图结构保真度与初始化有效性，并支持稳定、实时的 $1\mathrm{km}+$ 闭环 rollout。

title_en: Veda: Scalable Video Diffusion via Distilled Sparse Attention
title_zh: Veda：通过蒸馏稀疏注意力实现可扩展的视频扩散

sentences.en: Scaling Diffusion Transformers to generate high-resolution, long videos is constrained by the quadratic cost of self-attention, and existing sparse attention methods degrade under high sparsity.
sentences.zh: 将扩散 Transformer 扩展到生成高分辨率、长视频，受限于自注意力的二次代价，而现有的稀疏注意力方法在高稀疏度下会退化。

sentences.en: We show empirically that generation quality is determined not by the sparsity ratio itself, but by how well the sparse mask aligns with the tile-wise geometry of full attention.
sentences.zh: 我们通过实验表明，生成质量并不取决于稀疏度本身，而取决于稀疏掩码与全注意力的分块几何对齐得有多好。

sentences.en: Based on this insight, we propose Veda, a distilled sparse attention framework that formulates tile selection as an explicit reconstruction problem from full attention.
sentences.zh: 基于这一洞见，我们提出 Veda，一个蒸馏稀疏注意力框架，它将块选择表述为从全注意力进行显式重建的问题。

sentences.en: Veda integrates statistics-aware tile scoring with head-aware tiling to reduce estimation error and structural mismatch, enabling aggressive sparsity.
sentences.zh: Veda 将感知统计的块评分与感知头的分块相结合，以降低估计误差与结构不匹配，从而实现激进的稀疏化。

sentences.en: A hardware-efficient tile-skipping kernel converts theoretical sparsity into practical wall-clock speedups.
sentences.zh: 一个硬件高效的跳块内核将理论上的稀疏性转化为实际的时钟时间加速。

sentences.en: Experiments on large video diffusion models, including Waver and Wan2.1, demonstrate substantial acceleration with no noticeable degradation in generation quality.
sentences.zh: 在包括 Waver 与 Wan2.1 在内的大型视频扩散模型上的实验表明，该方法在生成质量无明显退化的情况下实现了大幅加速。

sentences.en: To generate 720P 10-second videos on Waver-T2V-12B, Veda achieves a 5.1$\times$ end-to-end speedup and a 10.5$\times$ self-attention speedup, reducing attention overhead from 92\% to 50\%.
sentences.zh: 为了在 Waver-T2V-12B 上生成 720P 的 10 秒视频，Veda 实现了 5.1$\times$ 的端到端加速与 10.5$\times$ 的自注意力加速，将注意力开销从 92\% 降低到 50\%。

sentences.en: Notably, the gains increase with sequence length, indicating that Veda scales favorably with spatiotemporal resolution across models.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，收益随序列长度增加而增大，这表明 Veda 能随着跨模型的时空分辨率而良好扩展。

title_en: Vegas: Self-Speculative Decoding with Verification-Guided Sparse Attention
title_zh: Vegas：使用验证引导的稀疏注意力的自投机解码

sentences.en: Long-context large language model (LLM) inference has become the norm for today's AI applications.
sentences.zh: 长上下文大语言模型（LLM）推断已成为当今 AI 应用的常态。

sentences.en: However, it is severely bottlenecked by the increasing memory demands of its KV cache.
sentences.zh: 然而，它受到 KV 缓存不断增加的内存需求的严重瓶颈制约。

sentences.en: Previous works have shown that self-speculative decoding with sparse attention, where tokens are drafted using a subset of the KV cache and verified in parallel against the full KV cache, speeds up inference in a lossless manner.
sentences.zh: 先前的工作表明，带稀疏注意力的自投机解码（使用 KV 缓存的一个子集来起草 token，并针对完整 KV 缓存并行验证）能够以无损的方式加速推断。

sentences.en: However, they rely on a standalone KV selection algorithm to select the KV entries used for drafting and overlook the fact that the criticality of each KV entry is inherently computed during verification.
sentences.zh: 然而，它们依赖独立的 KV 选择算法来挑选用于起草的 KV 条目，却忽略了每个 KV 条目的关键性本质上是在验证过程中计算出来的这一事实。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose Vegas, a self-speculative decoding method with verification-guided sparse attention.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出 Vegas，一种带验证引导稀疏注意力的自投机解码方法。

sentences.en: Vegas identifies critical KV cache entries as a byproduct of verification and computes attention only over these entries when drafting subsequent tokens.
sentences.zh: Vegas 将关键 KV 缓存条目的识别作为验证的副产品，并在起草后续 token 时仅对这些条目计算注意力。

sentences.en: This not only improves the draft token acceptance rate but also incurs low KV selection overhead, thereby improving decoding throughput.
sentences.zh: 这不仅能提高草稿 token 的接受率，还带来较低的 KV 选择开销，从而提升解码吞吐量。

sentences.en: Vegas achieves a 1.25$\times$–2.81$\times$ speedup in decoding throughput over default vLLM and a 1.15$\times$–1.29$\times$ speedup over state-of-the-art sparse attention-based self-speculative decoding methods.
sentences.zh: 相比默认 vLLM，Vegas 在解码吞吐量上实现了 1.25$\times$ 到 2.81$\times$ 的加速；相比基于稀疏注意力的最先进自投机解码方法，实现了 1.15$\times$ 到 1.29$\times$ 的加速。

sentences.en: Our code is available at https://github.com/platformxlab/vegas.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 https://github.com/platformxlab/vegas 获取。

title_en: VELR: Efficient Video Reward Feedback via Ensemble Latent Reward Models
title_zh: VELR：通过集成潜奖励模型实现高效的视频奖励反馈

sentences.en: Reward feedback learning (ReFL) is effective for both text-to-image (T2I) and text-to-video (T2V) generation with image reward models (RMs).
sentences.zh: 奖励反馈学习（Reward feedback learning, ReFL）借助图像奖励模型（reward models, RMs），对文生图（T2I）与文生视频（T2V）生成都有效。

sentences.en: However, image RMs are misaligned with temporal objectives of T2V, motivating ReFL with video reward models.
sentences.zh: 然而，图像 RM 与 T2V 的时序目标不匹配，这促使人们使用视频奖励模型进行 ReFL。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, directly deploying video RMs is impractical due to their large parameter size and the prohibitive cost of memory.
sentences.zh: 然而，由于视频 RM 参数规模庞大且内存成本高昂，直接部署它们并不现实。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose VELR: an efficient framework that employs ensemble latent reward models (LRMs) to predict rewards directly in latent space, bypassing expensive backpropagation through VAE decoders and video RMs.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出 VELR：一个采用集成潜奖励模型（latent reward models, LRMs）直接在潜空间预测奖励的高效框架，从而绕过了经由 VAE 解码器与视频 RM 的昂贵反向传播。

sentences.en: Specifically, we introduce the ensemble technique for the LRM, which enhances capacity, quantifies uncertainty, and mitigates reward hacking.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们为 LRM 引入了集成技术，它能增强容量、量化不确定性，并缓解奖励破解（reward hacking）。

sentences.en: VELR achieves a reduction of up to 150GB in memory, requiring as little as 12.4% of the memory compared to standard ReFL.
sentences.zh: VELR 最高可减少 150GB 内存，相较于标准 ReFL，内存占用仅为其 12.4%。

sentences.en: Experiments on OpenSora-1.2, CogVideoX-1.5, and Wan-2.1 with large-scale video RMs demonstrate that VELR achieves comparable performance as standard ReFL and enables efficient and robust video RM-based ReFL at scales previously unattainable.
sentences.zh: 在 OpenSora-1.2、CogVideoX-1.5 与 Wan-2.1 上配合大规模视频 RM 的实验表明，VELR 达到了与标准 ReFL 相当的性能，并使基于视频 RM 的 ReFL 能够在此前无法达到的规模下高效且稳健地运行。

title_en: VENOMREC: Cross-Modal Interactive Poisoning for Targeted Promotion in Multimodal LLM Recommender Systems
title_zh: VENOMREC：针对多模态 LLM 推荐系统中定向推广的跨模态交互式投毒

sentences.en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are pushing recommender systems (RecSys) toward content-grounded retrieval and ranking via cross-modal fusion.
sentences.zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）正通过跨模态融合，推动推荐系统（RecSys）向基于内容的检索与排序方向发展。

sentences.en: We find that while cross-modal consensus often mitigates conventional poisoning that manipulates interaction logs or perturbs a single modality, it also introduces a new attack surface where synchronised multimodal poisoning can reliably steer fused representations along stable semantic directions during fine-tuning.
sentences.zh: 我们发现，尽管跨模态一致性常常能缓解操纵交互日志或扰动单一模态的传统投毒，但它也引入了一种新的攻击面：在微调期间，同步的多模态投毒能够可靠地将融合表示沿稳定的语义方向引导。

sentences.en: To characterise this threat, we formalise cross-modal interactive poisoning and propose VENOMREC, which performs Exposure Alignment to identify high-exposure regions in the joint embedding space and Cross-modal Interactive Perturbation to craft attention-guided coupled token--patch edits.
sentences.zh: 为刻画这一威胁，我们形式化了跨模态交互式投毒，并提出 VENOMREC，它通过暴露对齐（Exposure Alignment）识别联合嵌入空间中的高暴露区域，并通过跨模态交互扰动（Cross-modal Interactive Perturbation）构造注意力引导的 token 与补丁耦合编辑。

sentences.en: Experiments on four real-world multimodal datasets demonstrate that VENOMREC consistently outperforms strong baselines,  achieving 0.73 mean ER@20 and improving over the strongest baseline by +0.52 absolute ER points on average, while maintaining comparable recommendation utility.
sentences.zh: 在四个真实世界多模态数据集上的实验表明，VENOMREC 持续优于强基线：平均 ER@20 达 0.73，平均相对最强基线提升 +0.52 个 ER 绝对分，同时保持相当的推荐效用。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/GuoweiGuan666/VenomRec.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/GuoweiGuan666/VenomRec 获取。

title_en: VenusBench-Mobile: A Challenging and User-Centric Benchmark for Mobile GUI Agents with Capability Diagnostics
title_zh: VenusBench-Mobile：面向移动 GUI 智能体的、具有能力诊断的挑战性用户中心基准

sentences.en: Existing online benchmarks for mobile GUI agents remain largely app-centric and task-homogeneous, failing to reflect the diversity and instability of real-world mobile usage.
sentences.zh: 现有的移动 GUI 智能体在线基准大多以应用为中心且任务同质化，未能反映真实移动使用的多样性与不稳定性。

sentences.en: To this end, we introduce VenusBench-Mobile, a challenging online benchmark for evaluating general-purpose mobile GUI agents under realistic, user-centric conditions.
sentences.zh: 为此，我们引入 VenusBench-Mobile，一个在真实、以用户为中心的条件下评估通用移动 GUI 智能体的挑战性在线基准。

sentences.en: VenusBench-Mobile builds two core evaluation pillars: defining what to evaluate via user-intent-driven task design that reflects real mobile usage, and how to evaluate through a capability-oriented annotation scheme for fine-grained agent behavior analysis.
sentences.zh: VenusBench-Mobile 构建了两大核心评估支柱：通过反映真实移动使用场景的用户意图驱动任务设计来定义“评估什么”；通过面向能力的标注方案来规定“如何评估”，以支持细粒度的智能体行为分析。

sentences.en: Extensive evaluation of state-of-the-art mobile GUI agents reveals large performance gaps relative to prior benchmarks, indicating that VenusBench-Mobile poses substantially more challenging and realistic tasks and that current agents remain far from reliable real-world deployment.
sentences.zh: 对最先进移动 GUI 智能体的大量评估揭示出相对先前基准的巨大性能差距，表明 VenusBench-Mobile 提出了显著更具挑战性、更贴近现实的任务，而当前智能体仍远未达到可靠的现实部署水平。

sentences.en: Diagnostic analysis further shows that failures are dominated by deficiencies in perception and memory, which are largely obscured by coarse-grained evaluations.
sentences.zh: 诊断分析进一步表明，失败主要由感知与记忆层面的不足占据主导，而这些不足大多被粗粒度的评估所掩盖。

sentences.en: Moreover, even the strongest agents exhibit near-zero success under environment variations, highlighting their brittleness in realistic settings.
sentences.zh: 此外，即使最强的智能体在环境变化下也几乎零成功率，凸显了它们在现实设定中的脆弱性。

sentences.en: Based on these insights, we believe VenusBench-Mobile provides an important stepping stone toward robust real-world deployment of mobile GUI agents.
sentences.zh: 基于这些洞见，我们相信 VenusBench-Mobile 为移动 GUI 智能体的稳健现实部署提供了一块重要的基石。

title_en: VEQ: Modality-Adaptive Quantization for MoE Vision-Language Models
title_zh: VEQ：面向 MoE 视觉-语言模型的模态自适应量化

sentences.en: Mixture-of-Experts(MoE) Vision-Language Models(VLMs) offer remarkable performance but incur prohibitive memory and computational costs, making compression essential.
sentences.zh: 专家混合（Mixture-of-Experts, MoE）视觉-语言模型（VLMs）性能卓著，但会带来高昂的内存与计算成本，因此压缩必不可少。

sentences.en: Post-Training Quantization (PTQ) is an effective training-free technique to address the massive memory and computation overhead.
sentences.zh: 训练后量化（Post-Training Quantization, PTQ）是一种有效的免训练技术，用于应对庞大的内存与计算开销。

sentences.en: Existing quantization paradigms fall short as they are oblivious to two critical forms of heterogeneity: the inherent discrepancy between vision and language tokens, and the non-uniform contribution of different experts.
sentences.zh: 现有的量化范式有所不足，因为它们忽视了两种关键形式的异质性：视觉 token 与语言 token 之间的固有差异，以及不同专家的非均匀贡献。

sentences.en: To bridge this gap, we introduce Visual Expert Quantization (VEQ), a dual-aware quantization framework designed to simultaneously accommodate cross-modal differences and heterogeneity between experts.
sentences.zh: 为弥合这一差距，我们引入视觉专家量化（Visual Expert Quantization, VEQ），一个双重感知的量化框架，旨在同时兼顾跨模态差异与专家之间的异质性。

sentences.en: Specifically, VEQ incorporates 1)**Modality-expert-aware Quantization**, which utilizes expert activation frequency to prioritize error minimization for pivotal experts, and 2)**Modality-affinity-aware Quantization**, which constructs an enhanced Hessian matrix by integrating token-expert affinity with modality information to guide the calibration process.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，VEQ 包含 1）**模态-专家感知量化**，它利用专家激活频率，优先为关键专家最小化误差；以及 2）**模态亲和感知量化**，它通过将 token-专家亲和度与模态信息整合，构建增强的 Hessian 矩阵来引导校准过程。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks verify that VEQ consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines.
sentences.zh: 跨多个多样基准的大量实验验证了 VEQ 持续优于最先进基线。

sentences.en: Specifically, under the W3A16 configuration, our method achieves significant average accuracy gains of 2.04\% on Kimi-VL and 3.09\% on Qwen3-VL compared to the previous SOTA quantization methods, demonstrating superior robustness across various multi-modal tasks.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，在 W3A16 配置下，相比先前的 SOTA 量化方法，我们的方法在 Kimi-VL 上取得平均 2.04\%、在 Qwen3-VL 上取得 3.09\% 的显著准确率提升，展现了在各种多模态任务上的强大鲁棒性。

title_en: VERA-V: Variational Inference Framework for Jailbreaking Vision-Language Models
title_zh: VERA-V：用于越狱视觉-语言模型的变分推断框架

sentences.en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) extend large language models with visual reasoning, but their multimodal design also introduces new, underexplored vulnerabilities.
sentences.zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLMs）通过视觉推理扩展了大语言模型，但它们多模态设计也引入了新的、尚未充分探索的脆弱性。

sentences.en: Existing multimodal red-teaming methods largely rely on brittle templates, focus on single-attack settings, and expose only a narrow subset of vulnerabilities.
sentences.zh: 现有的多模态红队方法大多依赖脆弱的模板，聚焦于单一攻击设定，且只暴露了很小一部分脆弱性。

sentences.en: To address these limitations, we introduce VERA-V, a variational inference framework that recasts multimodal jailbreak discovery as learning a joint posterior distribution over paired text-image prompts.
sentences.zh: 为克服这些局限，我们引入 VERA-V，一个将多模态越狱发现重新表述为学习配对文本-图像提示联合后验分布的变分推断框架。

sentences.en: This probabilistic view captures complex cross-modal interactions, enabling stealthy, coordinated adversarial inputs that bypass model guardrails.
sentences.zh: 这种概率视角能捕捉复杂的跨模态交互，从而生成可绕过模型安全护栏的隐蔽、协调对抗输入。

sentences.en: We train a lightweight attacker to approximate the posterior, allowing efficient sampling of diverse jailbreaks and providing distributional insights into vulnerabilities.
sentences.zh: 我们训练一个轻量级攻击者来逼近该后验，从而能够高效采样多样的越狱攻击，并提供关于脆弱性的分布性洞见。

sentences.en: VERA-V further integrates three complementary strategies: (i) typography-based text prompts that embed harmful cues, (ii) diffusion-based image synthesis that introduces adversarial signals, and (iii) structured distractors to fragment VLM attention.
sentences.zh: VERA-V 进一步整合了三种互补策略：（i）嵌入有害线索的、基于排版的文本提示；（ii）引入对抗信号的、基于扩散的图像合成；（iii）用于分散 VLM 注意力的结构化干扰项。

sentences.en: Experiments on HarmBench and HADES benchmarks show that VERA-V consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on both open-source and frontier VLMs, achieving up to 53.75\% higher attack success rate (ASR) over the best baseline on GPT-4o.
sentences.zh: 在 HarmBench 与 HADES 基准上的实验表明，VERA-V 在开源与前沿 VLM 上都持续优于最先进基线，在 GPT-4o 上相比最佳基线实现最高 53.75\% 的攻击成功率（ASR）提升。

sentences.en: We include the code on the project page available here: https://github.com/kxwhiowo/VERA-V
sentences.zh: 我们已将代码包含在项目页面中，可在此获取：https://github.com/kxwhiowo/VERA-V

title_en: Verbalized Bayesian Persuasion
title_zh: 言语化贝叶斯说服

sentences.en: Information design (ID) explores how a sender influence the optimal behavior of receivers to achieve specific objectives.
sentences.zh: 信息设计（Information design, ID）研究发送者如何影响接收者的最优行为以实现特定目标。

sentences.en: While ID originates from everyday human communication, existing game-theoretic and learning methods often model information structures as numbers, which limits many applications to toy games.
sentences.zh: 尽管 ID 源于日常人际沟通，但现有的博弈论与学习方法常常将信息结构建模为数字，这使得许多应用只能局限于玩具游戏。

sentences.en: This work leverages LLMs and proposes a verbalized framework in Bayesian persuasion (BP), which extends classic BP to real-world games involving human dialogues for the first time.
sentences.zh: 本工作利用 LLM，提出一个贝叶斯说服（Bayesian persuasion, BP）中的言语化框架，首次将经典 BP 扩展到涉及人类对话的真实世界博弈中。

sentences.en: We map the BP to a verbalized mediator-augmented game, where LLMs instantiate the sender and receiver.
sentences.zh: 我们将 BP 映射到一个言语化的、带调解人的增强博弈中，由 LLM 实例化发送者与接收者。

sentences.en: To efficiently solve the verbalized game, we propose a generalized equilibrium-finding algorithm combining LLM and game solver.
sentences.zh: 为高效求解这一言语化博弈，我们提出一个结合 LLM 与博弈求解器的广义均衡求解算法。

sentences.en: The algorithm is reinforced with techniques including verbalized commitment assumptions, verbalized obedience constraints, and information obfuscation.
sentences.zh: 该算法通过多种技术进行强化，包括言语化承诺假设、言语化服从约束与信息混淆。

sentences.en: Experiments in dialogue scenarios, such as recommendation letters, law enforcement, diplomacy with press, validate that our framework can reproduce theoretical results in classic BP and discover effective persuasion strategies in more complex natural language and multi-stage scenarios.
sentences.zh: 在推荐信、执法、面向媒体的外交等对话场景中的实验验证，我们的框架能够复现经典 BP 的理论结果，并在更复杂的自然语言与多阶段场景中发现有效的说服策略。

title_en: Verbalized Sampling: How to Mitigate Mode Collapse and Unlock LLM Diversity
title_zh: 言语化采样：如何缓解模式坍缩并释放 LLM 多样性

sentences.en: Post-training alignment often reduces LLM diversity, leading to a phenomenon known as mode collapse.
sentences.zh: 训练后的对齐常常会降低 LLM 的多样性，导致一种被称为“模式坍缩”（mode collapse）的现象。

sentences.en: Unlike prior work that attributes this effect to algorithmic limitations, we identify a fundamental, pervasive data-level driver: typicality bias in preference data, whereby annotators systematically favor familiar text as a result of well-established findings in cognitive psychology.
sentences.zh: 与将这一效应归因于算法局限的先前工作不同，我们识别出一个根本且普遍的数据层面诱因：偏好数据中的典型性偏差（typicality bias），即标注者会根据认知心理学中已充分确立的发现，系统性地偏好熟悉的文本。

sentences.en: We formalize this bias theoretically, verify it empirically on preference datasets, and show that it plays a central role in mode collapse.
sentences.zh: 我们从理论上形式化这一偏差，在偏好数据集上实证验证它，并表明它在模式坍缩中起着核心作用。

sentences.en: Motivated by this analysis, we introduce Verbalized Sampling (VS), a simple, training-free prompting strategy to circumvent mode collapse.
sentences.zh: 受这一分析的启发，我们引入言语化采样（Verbalized Sampling, VS），一种简单、免训练的提示策略，用于规避模式坍缩。

sentences.en: VS prompts the model to verbalize a probability distribution over a set of responses (e.g., "Generate 5 jokes about coffee and their corresponding probabilities"), which relieves the pressure to produce a single "typical" answer.
sentences.zh: VS 提示模型言语化输出一组响应上的概率分布（例如“生成 5 个关于咖啡的笑话及其对应概率”），从而缓解了必须产出一个单一“典型”答案的压力。

sentences.en: Experiments show that VS significantly improves performance across creative writing (poems, stories, jokes), social dialogue simulation, synthetic data generation, and open-ended QA, without sacrificing safety and factual accuracy.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，VS 在创意写作（诗歌、故事、笑话）、社交对话模拟、合成数据生成与开放式问答等方面显著提升性能，同时不牺牲安全性与事实准确性。

sentences.en: For instance, in creative writing, VS increases diversity by 1.6-2.1x compared to direct prompting.
sentences.zh: 例如，在创意写作中，与直接提示相比，VS 将多样性提升了 1.6-2.1 倍。

sentences.en: We further observe an emergent trend that more capable models benefit more from VS.
sentences.zh: 我们还观察到一种涌现趋势：能力越强的模型越能从 VS 中受益。

sentences.en: In sum, our work provides a new data-centric perspective on mode collapse and a practical inference-time remedy that helps unlock pre-trained generative diversity.
sentences.zh: 总而言之，我们的工作为模式坍缩提供了一个新的以数据为中心的视角，并提供了一种实用的推断时补救措施，有助于释放预训练模型的生成多样性。

title_en: Verified SHAP: Provable Bounds for Exact Shapley Values of Neural Networks
title_zh: 已验证 SHAP：神经网络精确 Shapley 值的可证界

sentences.en: Shapley additive explanations (SHAP) are widely recognised as computationally intractable for neural networks, since they induce an exponential search space over the input features.
sentences.zh: Shapley 加性解释（SHAP）被普遍认为在神经网络上是计算上难以处理的，因为它们会在输入特征上产生指数级的搜索空间。

sentences.en: In this work, we take a first step towards scaling exact SHAP computation to larger search spaces by introducing an algorithm that leverages recent advances in neural network verification to compute arbitrarily tight exact lower and upper bounds on SHAP values for neural networks, ultimately recovering the exact SHAP values.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们向将精确 SHAP 计算扩展到更大搜索空间迈出第一步：引入一种利用神经网络验证领域最新进展的算法，为神经网络的 SHAP 值计算任意紧的精确下界与上界，最终恢复精确的 SHAP 值。

sentences.en: We demonstrate that our approach scales to orders of magnitude larger search spaces than state-of-the-art exact methods.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，与最先进的精确方法相比，我们的方法能扩展到更大几个数量级的搜索空间。

sentences.en: This provides an important first step towards exact SHAP computation and establishes a principled cornerstone for evaluating statistical approximation methods on larger search spaces.
sentences.zh: 这为精确 SHAP 计算提供了重要的第一步，并为在更大搜索空间上评估统计近似方法奠定了原则性基石。

title_en: Verifying Meta-Awareness via Predictive Rewards in Reasoning Models
title_zh: 通过推理模型中的预测奖励验证元意识

sentences.en: Recent research on reasoning models explores the meta-awareness of language models, including their ability to determine optimal thinking duration, recognize knowledge boundaries, and structure concept-level thinking.
sentences.zh: 近期关于推理模型的研究探索了语言模型的元意识（meta-awareness），包括它们确定最优思考时长、识别知识边界以及组织概念级思考的能力。

sentences.en: While current large reasoning models depend solely on answer-based verification, we show that adding meta-awareness objectives leads to significant performance gains over models without such meta-knowledge.
sentences.zh: 尽管当前的大型推理模型仅依赖基于答案的验证，我们表明，加入元意识目标能比缺乏此类元知识的模型带来显著的性能提升。

sentences.en: **MAPR** utilizes a self-generated task of predicting rollout statistics - specifically length, pass-rate, and concepts used - allowing for verification against the actual statistics.
sentences.zh: **MAPR** 利用一个自生成的“预测 rollout 统计量”任务，具体包括长度、通过率与使用的概念，从而可以针对真实统计量进行验证。

sentences.en: Furthermore, by leveraging this self-predictive capability, the model can regulate its reasoning behavior by i) filtering out trivial or unsolvable prompts, ii) reducing lengthy generations that tend to be incorrect, and iii) generating hints relevant to the problem.
sentences.zh: 此外，通过利用这种自我预测能力，模型可以规范自身的推理行为：i）过滤掉琐碎或无法解决的提示；ii）减少往往出错的长篇生成；iii）生成与问题相关的提示。

sentences.en: The results are promising: **MAPR** yields significant improvements in both accuracy and training efficiency on various reasoning benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 结果是令人振奋的：**MAPR** 在多种推理基准上，无论在准确率还是训练效率方面都带来了显著改进。

sentences.en: More specifically, our method can speed up GRPO training by over 1.28$\times$ to reach the same performance, and achieve 83.18\% gain in accuracy on AIME25, and a 16.45\% average gain over six mathematics benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 更具体地说，我们的方法能以超过 1.28$\times$ 的加速完成 GRPO 训练并达到相同性能，在 AIME25 上取得 83.18\% 的准确率提升，并在六个数学基准上取得平均 16.45\% 的提升。

title_en: VeriSimpl: Robust Optimization Modeling from Natural Language using Simplification-based Verification
title_zh: VeriSimpl：基于简化验证的自然语言稳健优化建模

sentences.en: Natural language interfaces can greatly benefit the accessibility and usability of optimization modeling, and recent advances in large language models (LLMs) show promise in automatically translating textual problem descriptions into executable solver formulations.
sentences.zh: 自然语言接口能极大地提升优化建模的可及性与易用性，而近期大语言模型（LLMs）的进展在将文本问题描述自动翻译为可执行的求解器公式方面展现出前景。

sentences.en: However, a key challenge for existing approaches is to ensure that the inferred formulation correctly implements the intended task, even if it may execute without errors.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有方法的一个关键挑战是确保推断出的公式能正确实现预期任务，即便它可能能够无错误地执行。

sentences.en: We introduce VeriSimpl, a solver–LLM framework for robust natural-language-to-optimization formalization.
sentences.zh: 我们引入 VeriSimpl，一个用于稳健的自然语言到优化形式化转换的求解器-LLM 框架。

sentences.en: Our approach is based on the idea of simplification-based verification, where the optimization solver is leveraged to generate simplified diagnostic queries about a candidate formulation to allow the LLM to tractably reason about the correctness of the formulation with respect to the task description.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法基于简化式验证的思想：利用优化求解器针对候选公式生成简化的诊断查询，使 LLM 能够可处理地推理该公式相对于任务描述的正确性。

sentences.en: We present such simplification strategies along different dimensions with respect to problem constraints and decision variables, which allow the LLM to reason locally under fixed global contexts.
sentences.zh: 我们针对问题约束与决策变量，从不同维度提出此类简化策略，使 LLM 能在固定的全局上下文下进行局部推理。

sentences.en: Evaluations on a range of optimization benchmarks show how our approach provides consistent improvements in accuracy over existing methods, while also providing a novel high-precision self-verification signal.
sentences.zh: 在一系列优化基准上的评估表明，我们的方法在准确率上提供了相对现有方法的一致改进，同时还提供了一种新颖的高精度自我验证信号。

title_en: VeRO: A Harness for Agents to Optimize Agents
title_zh: VeRO：让智能体优化智能体的工具架

sentences.en: An important emerging application of coding agents is *agent harness optimization*: the iterative improvement of a *target agent* by editing and evaluating its code.
sentences.zh: 编码智能体的一个重要新兴应用是*智能体工具架优化*（agent harness optimization）：通过编辑与评估*目标智能体*的代码来对其进行迭代式改进。

sentences.en: Despite its relevance, the community lacks a systematic understanding of coding agent performance on this task.
sentences.zh: 尽管这一任务很有价值，但社区对编码智能体在此任务上表现的系统性理解仍然缺乏。

sentences.en: Harness optimization differs from conventional software engineering: agent harnesses interleave deterministic code with stochastic LLM completions, requiring structured capture of both intermediate execution traces and downstream outcomes.
sentences.zh: 工具架优化不同于常规软件工程：智能体工具架将确定性代码与随机的 LLM 补全交织在一起，因此需要结构化地捕获中间执行轨迹与下游结果。

sentences.en: To address these challenges, we introduce (1) VeRO (Versioning, Rewards, and Observations), an *outer harness* that provides versioned snapshots, budget-controlled evaluation, and structured execution traces of *target harnesses*, and (2) VeRO-Bench, a benchmark suite of target agents and tasks with reference evaluation procedures.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们引入（1）VeRO（版本管理、奖励与观测，Versioning, Rewards, and Observations），一个*外部工具架*，提供*目标工具架*的版本化快照、受预算控制的评估与结构化执行轨迹；（2）VeRO-Bench，一个包含目标智能体与任务、并配以参考评估流程的基准套件。

sentences.en: Using VeRO, we conduct an empirical study comparing optimizers across tasks and analyzing which modifications reliably improve target agent harnesses.
sentences.zh: 借助 VeRO，我们开展了一项实证研究，跨任务比较各优化器，并分析哪些修改能可靠地改进目标智能体工具架。

sentences.en: We release VeRO to support research on agent optimization as a core capability for coding agents.
sentences.zh: 我们发布 VeRO，以支持将智能体优化作为编码智能体核心能力的研究。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/scaleapi/vero.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/scaleapi/vero 获取。

title_en: Very Efficient Listwise Multimodal Reranking for Long Documents
title_zh: 面向长文档的高效列表式多模态重排序

sentences.en: Listwise reranking is a critical yet costly component in vision-centric retrieval and multimodal retrieval-augmented generation (M-RAG) over long documents.
sentences.zh: 列表式重排序是长文档上以视觉为中心的检索与多模态检索增强生成（M-RAG）中一个关键而又昂贵的组成部分。

sentences.en: Although recent VLM-based rerankers achieve strong accuracy, they are often impractical due to long visual-token inputs and autoregressive decoding, resulting in high latency.
sentences.zh: 尽管近期基于 VLM 的重排序器取得了很高的准确率，但由于视觉 token 输入较长且采用自回归解码，它们往往不切实际，延迟很高。

sentences.en: We propose ZipRerank, a very efficient listwise multimodal reranker that directly addresses both bottlenecks: it shortens the input via query-image early interaction and eliminates multi-step generation by scoring all candidates in a single forward pass.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 ZipRerank，一个非常高效的列表式多模态重排序器，直接解决这两个瓶颈：它通过查询-图像早期交互缩短输入，并通过单次前向传播对所有候选打分来消除多步生成。

sentences.en: ZipRerank is trained with a two-stage recipe: listwise pretraining on large-scale text reranking data rendered as images, followed by multimodal finetuning with VLM-teacher supervision and a soft-ranking objective to handle noisy rankings.
sentences.zh: ZipRerank 采用两阶段方案训练：先在渲染为图像的大规模文本重排序数据上进行列表式预训练，再结合 VLM 教师监督与软排序目标进行多模态微调，以处理含噪声的排序。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on the MMDocIR benchmark demonstrate that ZipRerank matches or surpasses state-of-the-art multimodal rerankers while reducing LLM inference latency by up to an order of magnitude, making it well-suited for latency-sensitive real-world systems.
sentences.zh: 在 MMDocIR 基准上的大量实验表明，ZipRerank 与最先进的多模态重排序器持平或更优，同时将 LLM 推断延迟降低最多一个数量级，非常适合对延迟敏感的真实世界系统。

sentences.en: Source code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ZipRerank.
sentences.zh: 源代码可在 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ZipRerank 获取。

title_en: VFMF: Dense Forecasting by Generating Foundation Model Features
title_zh: VFMF：通过生成基础模型特征进行密集预测

sentences.en: Forecasting by generating RGB videos is computationally expensive, often physically implausible, and not directly actionable, since it requires translation into decision-making signals.
sentences.zh: 通过生成 RGB 视频来进行预测，计算开销大、常常在物理上不成立，并且不能直接可用，因为还需要将视频转译成决策信号。

sentences.en: Direct modality forecasting (e.g., predicting future segmentation) produces directly actionable outputs but fails to scale due to the need for labels.
sentences.zh: 直接模态预测（例如预测未来的分割结果）能产生直接可用的输出，但因对标签的需求而难以扩展。

sentences.en: Vision Foundation Model (VFM) features offer the best of both worlds: they contain actionable semantic and geometric information that can be easily decoded from the predicted features, while requiring no labels on the downstream task for training.
sentences.zh: 视觉基础模型（VFM）特征兼得两者之长：它们包含可从预测特征中轻松解码的可操作语义与几何信息，同时在训练下游任务时无需任何标签。

sentences.en: However, almost all existing VFM feature forecasting methods regress future features from fixed number of input frames, with evaluation predominantly on short horizons matching the training setup.
sentences.zh: 然而，几乎所有现有的 VFM 特征预测方法都从固定数量的输入帧回归未来特征，且评估主要在与训练设定匹配的短预测范围内进行。

sentences.en: We firstly show that existing regression methods struggle with forecasting from partial observations because they average over multiple plausible futures, failing to capture uncertainty in the future given the past.
sentences.zh: 我们首先证明，现有回归方法难以从部分观测进行预测，因为它们会对多种可能的未来取平均，无法捕捉在给定过去条件下的未来不确定性。

sentences.en: Interestingly, naively replacing deterministic forecasting with generative flow matching does not match the sample quality of the regression model, despite being a mathematically appropriate formulation of the forecasting task.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，尽管生成式流匹配在数学上是预测任务的恰当表述，但简单地将确定性预测替换为生成式流匹配，却达不到回归模型的样本质量。

sentences.en: In this work, we explain why this is the case, and we show how to optimally generate foundation model features.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们解释了为什么会这样，并展示了如何最优地生成基础模型特征。

sentences.en: Our key insight is that generative modeling of VFM features requires (auto)encoding into a compact latent space suitable for diffusion.
sentences.zh: 我们的关键洞见是，VFM 特征的生成建模需要（自）编码到适合扩散的紧凑潜空间中。

sentences.en: We show that this latent space preserves information more effectively than previously used alternatives, such as uncompressed feature diffusion or PCA-based compression, both for forecasting and other applications, such as image generation.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，无论是在预测还是在图像生成等其他应用中，这一潜空间都比此前使用的替代方案（如未压缩的特征扩散或基于 PCA 的压缩）能更有效地保留信息。

sentences.en: Our results suggest that conditional generation of (compressed) VFM features offers a promising and scalable foundation for future scene forecasters.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果表明，对（压缩后的）VFM 特征进行条件生成，为未来的场景预测器提供了一个有前景且可扩展的基础。

title_en: VGGT-Motion: Motion-Aware Calibration-Free Monocular SLAM for Long-Range Consistency
title_zh: VGGT-Motion：面向长距离一致性的运动感知免标定单目 SLAM

sentences.en: Despite recent progress in calibration-free monocular SLAM via 3D vision foundation models, scale drift remains severe on long sequences.
sentences.zh: 尽管借助 3D 视觉基础模型，免标定单目 SLAM 取得了近期进展，但在长序列上尺度漂移仍然严重。

sentences.en: Motion-agnostic partitioning breaks contextual coherence and causes zero-motion drift, while conventional geometric alignment is computationally expensive.
sentences.zh: 与运动无关的分割会破坏上下文连贯性并引发零运动漂移，而传统的几何对齐则计算开销很高。

sentences.en: To address these issues, we propose VGGT-Motion, a calibration-free SLAM system for efficient and robust global consistency over kilometer-scale trajectories.
sentences.zh: 为解决这些问题，我们提出 VGGT-Motion，一个面向公里级轨迹上高效、鲁棒全局一致性的免标定 SLAM 系统。

sentences.en: Specifically, we first propose a motion-aware submap construction mechanism that uses optical flow to guide adaptive partitioning, prune static redundancy, and encapsulate turns for stable local geometry.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们首先提出一个运动感知的子图构建机制，利用光流引导自适应分割、修剪静态冗余，并封装转弯以维持稳定的局部几何。

sentences.en: We then design an anchor-driven direct Sim(3) registration strategy.
sentences.zh: 随后我们设计一种锚点驱动的直接 Sim(3) 配准策略。

sentences.en: By exploiting context-balanced anchors, it achieves search-free, pixel-wise dense alignment and efficient loop closure without costly feature matching.
sentences.zh: 通过利用上下文平衡的锚点，它实现了免搜索的逐像素密集对齐与高效闭环，无需昂贵的特征匹配。

sentences.en: Finally, a lightweight submap-level pose graph optimization enforces global consistency with linear complexity, enabling scalable long-range operation.
sentences.zh: 最后，一个轻量级的子图级位姿图优化以线性复杂度强制执行全局一致性，实现可扩展的长距离运行。

sentences.en: Experiments show that VGGT-Motion markedly improves trajectory accuracy and efficiency, achieving state-of-the-art performance in zero-shot, long-range calibration-free monocular SLAM.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，VGGT-Motion 显著提升了轨迹精度与效率，在零样本、长距离的免标定单目 SLAM 中取得了最先进的性能。

title_en: VIA-SD: Verification via Intra-Model Routing for Speculative Decoding
title_zh: VIA-SD：通过模型内部路由进行投机解码验证

sentences.en: Speculative decoding (SD) addresses the high inference costs of LLMs by having lightweight drafters generate candidates for large verifiers to validate in parallel.
sentences.zh: 投机解码（Speculative decoding, SD）通过让轻量级起草器生成候选，交由大型验证器并行验证，来解决 LLM 的高推断成本问题。

sentences.en: Existing draft-verify methods use binary decisions: accept or fully recompute.
sentences.zh: 现有的草稿-验证方法使用二值决策：要么接受，要么完全重新计算。

sentences.en: Yet we find that many rejected tokens can be verified correctly by a slim submodel derived from the full verifier via intra-model routing, instead of the full verifier.
sentences.zh: 然而我们发现，许多被拒绝的 token 可以由从完整验证器通过模型内部路由派生的精简子模型正确验证，而无需动用完整验证器。

sentences.en: This motivates our slim-verifier to handle tokens requiring moderate verification resources, reducing expensive large-model calls.
sentences.zh: 这促使我们的精简验证器处理需要中等验证资源的 token，从而减少昂贵的大型模型调用。

sentences.en: We propose **V**erification via **I**ntr**a**-Model Routing for **S**peculative **D**ecoding (VIA-SD), a multi-tier framework using a routed slim-verifier.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 **V**erification via **I**ntr**a**-Model Routing for **S**peculative **D**ecoding（VIA-SD），一个使用路由精简验证器的多层框架。

sentences.en: Draft tokens are processed hierarchically: direct acceptance for high-confidence cases, slim-verifier regeneration for medium-confidence cases, and full-model verification for uncertain cases.
sentences.zh: 草稿 token 被分层处理：高置信情况直接接受，中等置信情况由精简验证器重新生成，不确定情况则由完整模型验证。

sentences.en: Across four representative tasks and multiple model families, VIA-SD reduces rejection rates by 0.10–0.22 and delivers 10–20% speedups over strong SD baselines, while achieving 2.5–3× acceleration over non-drafting decoding.
sentences.zh: 在四个代表性任务与多个模型族上，VIA-SD 将拒绝率降低了 0.10 到 0.22，相比强 SD 基线带来了 10 到 20% 的加速，并相对非草稿解码实现了 2.5 到 3 倍的加速。

sentences.en: Moreover, VIA-SD is compatible with existing SD frameworks without modifying their training procedures.
sentences.zh: 此外，VIA-SD 与现有 SD 框架兼容，而无需修改它们的训练流程。

sentences.en: Our results suggest multi-tier SD as a general paradigm for scalable and efficient LLM inference.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果表明，多层 SD 是面向可扩展且高效 LLM 推断的一种通用范式。

sentences.en: Project page: https://zju-xyc.github.io/VIA-SD-Project-Page/
sentences.zh: 项目页面：https://zju-xyc.github.io/VIA-SD-Project-Page/
